description: Write blocks of cell values. Each block is one contiguous range with a 2D `values` array (a scalar for one cell). `expected` (same shape; exact text, sha256:<hash>, or null to skip a cell) is the base check: a block whose current content differs is skipped as a conflict, never half-written. After writing, every block is read back and compared (status written-verified / written-mismatch). Values are interpreted like typed input: text that looks like a number/date may be converted — mismatches report it.

file.description: Workbook: SharePoint URL, an alias from ~/.graph-excel/workbooks.json, or "driveId:itemId"

send.description: false (default) = dry run: shows what would change. true = write — only after the user approved (or a standing rule allows it)

sheet.description: Worksheet name exactly as listed by resolve

name: write_values
